# Historical publisher observations

observations.json is a minimized, scope-annotated research fixture built from
the unchanged official response captures already retained under
build/batch004-autonomous-20261007 and build/black-clover-membership.
Source URLs, original Japanese story headings, book identifiers, capture times,
payload hashes and TOC locators are retained. prepare_fixtures.py documents the
exact extraction and verifies the two HTML capture hashes.

Dr. STONE's four observed supplementary TOC stories are explicitly annotated
in this **test fixture**, not a shipped title-specific table or automatic title
matching rule. Their official Japanese volume membership does not prove an
English acquisition binding. MHA's fanbook heading and Black Clover's two
guidebook/pilot headings are also unbound. No full-content equality is asserted.

No production database was accessed. All provider labels remain independent;
page positions and book IDs never become numeric canonical chapter identifiers.
